limits: Only the frozen files listed in inputs.json; later downloads are excluded.
This dashboard measures native Rust import and reference_conditions calculations only. Separate batch validation and pinned-PoB2 triage reports describe their own scope.
The dashboard does not assert numerical agreement; a successful test process does not mean all values agree.
Reference values are embedded exporter results of unknown version, not confirmed game truth.
Damage uses the main skill minion's nonzero TotalDPS when available, otherwise the player's TotalDPS; it is not a full-build DPS total.
Only comparable exported display rows are measured; unsupported mechanics and all import-loss categories are not covered by the aggregate agreement rate.
Values in the per-row difference files are rounded to two decimal places by the existing dashboard; pass/fail decisions used full engine precision.
Unsupported line occurrences are summed per build and may repeat across builds.
